TITLE: Board Card – More Actions Button Sits Beside the Status Label, Not Over It
STATUS: FILED as SV-11753 26 Oct 2026 (Chris Ward asked in comment 79481). FILING APPROVED by the QA lead 26 Oct 2026 ("Create the ticket tell Chris everything and ask him to confirm if this is acceptable this way ... with the annotated screenshots from Design VS Build").
Fields: Bug · parent SV-11593 (Board/Tech View Fast Follow) · Medium · Product Area Work Orders · labels board-tech-view, fast-follow · relates to SV-10046

h2. Description

*What the design requires:* when the mouse is over a Board View card, the *…* (More actions) button appears at the card's top right, *over the right end of the status label*, covering part of it. The design names this state "board card menu button over badge". The PRD only says the button appears on hover or keyboard focus (*S3-R13*) and says nothing about where it sits, so the design is the source for its position.

*What happens instead:* the *…* button appears *beside* the status label, to its left, and the status label is shown in full.

For example:

* on an Approved work order the design shows *Appro…* with the *…* button on top of the rest of the word
* the build shows the full word *Approved* with the *…* button in a space to its left

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in and open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab and click *Board View* in the display switcher.
# Find the card of any work order with a status label (e.g. *Approved*).
# Move the mouse over the card.
#* The card's border darkens and the *…* button appears at the top right.
#* The *…* button sits to the left of the status label; the label is not covered.

*Actual Result:*

* The *…* button sits beside the status label, to its left.

*Expected Result:*

* As in the design, the *…* button sits over the right end of the status label.
